# Levni

> Levni is an open-source design engine for AI agents. It draws covers, icons, charts, brand boards and poster series from a short JSON scene, on your own machine: no image model, no API key, $0 per image. Code MIT, drawings CC BY 4.0: a library of 1,600+ hand-inked drawings and an MCP server for Claude, Codex and Cursor. Made by Ortak Alan (https://ortakalan.io), a Turkish publication that draws its own covers with it.

Install for Claude Code: `claude mcp add levni -- npx -y @levni/levni mcp`. npm: `@levni/levni`. MCP Registry: `dev.levni/levni`. Source: https://github.com/Levni-Dev/levni (code MIT, drawings CC BY 4.0). Full docs text in one file: https://levni.dev/llms-full.txt

## Start here

- [Getting started](https://levni.dev/docs/getting-started/): install and draw a first image in two minutes
- [MCP server](https://levni.dev/mcp/): tools for agents, setup for every client
- [Scene format](https://levni.dev/docs/scenes/): canvas, colours, formats and the layout critic
- [Elements](https://levni.dev/docs/elements/): every element type a scene can use
- [CLI](https://levni.dev/docs/cli/) and [Node API](https://levni.dev/docs/api/)
- [Levni Skills](https://github.com/Levni-Dev/levni-skills): agent skills for art direction and motion, with sixteen recipe cards (`npx skills add Levni-Dev/levni-skills`)
- [Levni Pen](https://levni.dev/pen/): a live playground for scene JSON, with motion, share links and forks
- [Your year in code](https://levni.dev/you/): a moving card from a GitHub profile
- [Reel](https://levni.dev/docs/reel/), [Stamp and remix](https://levni.dev/docs/stamp/), [README banner Action](https://levni.dev/docs/readme-action/)
- [Levni Shots](https://levni.dev/shots/): 25 ready-made motion shots that take your title, drawing and inks, every format ([guide](https://levni.dev/docs/shots/))
- [Print](https://levni.dev/docs/print/): split a scene into riso plates, one grayscale image per ink, ready for a stencil printer
- [Motion catalogue](https://levni.dev/motion/): every animation preset, camera move, easing and self-moving element as a small loop with its JSON
- [Animation](https://levni.dev/docs/animation/): any scene as a looping GIF, animated WebP or MP4; motion on any element, stagger, camera
- [Brand kits](https://levni.dev/docs/brand-kits/), [Storyboards](https://levni.dev/docs/storyboards/) and [Export](https://levni.dev/docs/export/): frames, sprite sheets, transparent PNGs, seamless tiles

## Make things

- [Free makers](https://levni.dev/make/): stickers, posters, brand boards, icons, ASCII art and more, in the browser
- [Editor](https://levni.dev/editor/): a free design editor that runs Levni in the page
- [README banner maker](https://levni.dev/banner/): a banner from a GitHub link, as a PNG or an animated GIF
- [Free tools](https://levni.dev/tools/): [mesh gradient generator](https://levni.dev/tools/mesh-gradient-generator/), [SVG pattern generator](https://levni.dev/tools/svg-pattern-generator/), [blob and wave generator](https://levni.dev/tools/blob-wave-generator/), [OG image generator](https://levni.dev/tools/og-image-generator/)
- [Gallery](https://levni.dev/gallery/): every image with the scene that drew it
- [Library](https://levni.dev/library/): the Levni Folio, 1,600+ drawings searchable in English and Turkish

## No FOMO lists (open-source design, curated by Levni-Dev)

- [Awesome Open Design](https://levni.dev/lists/open-design/): open design tools, icon sets, illustrations, fonts, colour and creative code ([GitHub](https://github.com/Levni-Dev/awesome-open-design), data: data/entries.json, CC0)
- [Awesome Design MCP](https://levni.dev/lists/design-mcp/): open-source MCP servers that let AI agents do design work ([GitHub](https://github.com/Levni-Dev/awesome-design-mcp))
- [Awesome Lettering](https://levni.dev/lists/lettering/): open type design tools, fonts, lettering and kinetic type ([GitHub](https://github.com/Levni-Dev/awesome-lettering))

## About

- [Manifesto](https://levni.dev/manifesto/): why Levni exists, the Tulip Era and the FOMO stack
- [Community](https://levni.dev/community/): five ways to add drawings, palettes, brand kits and showcases
- [Join the crew](https://levni.dev/join/): the Levni letter and the Folio crew Wanted list
- [Blog](https://levni.dev/blog/): guides and stories, RSS at https://levni.dev/blog/rss.xml
- [Changelog](https://levni.dev/changelog/)

## In Turkish (Ortak Alan guides)

Ortak Alan, the publication that makes Levni, writes the Turkish guides:

- [Yapay zekâ ile ücretsiz görsel üretme](https://ortakalan.io/atolye/yapay-zeka-ile-ucretsiz-gorsel-uretme/): free ways to make images with AI
- [Blog kapak görseli nasıl yapılır?](https://ortakalan.io/atolye/blog-kapak-gorseli-nasil-yapilir/): blog cover sizes and a free method
- [MCP nedir?](https://ortakalan.io/atolye/mcp-nedir/): what MCP is and how to set it up
- [Tasarım için MCP sunucuları](https://ortakalan.io/atolye/tasarim-icin-mcp-sunuculari/): MCP servers for design work
- [Sosyal medya görsel boyutları](https://ortakalan.io/atolye/sosyal-medya-gorsel-boyutlari/): social media image sizes
- [Ücretsiz illüstrasyon ve lisanslar](https://ortakalan.io/atolye/ucretsiz-illustrasyon-ve-lisanslar/): free illustrations and their licences
- [Açık kaynak tasarım araçları](https://ortakalan.io/atolye/acik-kaynak-tasarim-araclari/): open-source design tools, by job
